entities.name: Operator-defined access category definitions
entities.description: This information element is used to assign new operator-defined access category definitions to the UE or delete existing operator-defined access category definitions at the UE.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The UE is the device that receives and processes the operator-defined access category definitions.

entities.name: Assign operator-defined access categories
entities.description: Condition where the IE is included to assign new operator-defined access category definitions to the UE.

entities.name: Delete operator-defined access categories
entities.description: Condition where the IE is included to delete existing operator-defined access category definitions at the UE.

relations.description: The IE may be included to assign new operator-defined access category definitions to the UE.
The IE may be included to delete operator-defined access category definitions at the UE.
Assigning new operator-defined access category definitions establishes updated definitions at the UE.
Deleting operator-defined access category definitions establishes removal of definitions at the UE.
